_note: Starter catalogue of common generic OBD-II codes. Titles follow the standard SAE-style wording. Causes and checks are POSSIBILITIES, not diagnoses. Review against a trusted reference before relying on it, and extend as needed.

P0100.description: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit Malfunction
possible_causes: Intake air leak or contaminated sensor element
follow_up_checks: Inspect MAF sensor connector and wiring
Check the intake tract for leaks or a dirty sensor

P0101.description: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit Range/Performance Problem
follow_up_checks: Inspect air filter and intake ducting
Compare airflow reading with a known-good value at idle

P0102.description: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit Low Input
follow_up_checks: Check sensor wiring and connector
Check sensor supply voltage and signal

P0103.description: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit High Input
follow_up_checks: Check sensor wiring and connector
Check sensor signal against specification

P0113.description: Intake Air Temperature Circuit High Input
follow_up_checks: Inspect IAT sensor connector
Compare sensor reading with ambient temperature

P0117.description: Engine Coolant Temperature Circuit Low Input
follow_up_checks: Inspect ECT sensor and wiring
Compare sensor reading with actual engine temperature

P0118.description: Engine Coolant Temperature Circuit High Input
follow_up_checks: Inspect ECT sensor and wiring
Compare sensor reading with actual engine temperature

possible_causes: Low fuel pressure or clogged injector
follow_up_checks: Smoke-test or inspect for intake leaks
Check fuel pressure and fuel trims

possible_causes: Leaking injector or high fuel pressure
follow_up_checks: Check fuel pressure and injectors
Check air filter and fuel trims

possible_causes: Worn spark plugs or ignition coils
Fuel delivery or air leak problem
follow_up_checks: Inspect spark plugs and coils
Check fuel trims and run a compression test if misfire persists

possible_causes: Spark plug or ignition coil on cylinder 1
follow_up_checks: Swap coil with another cylinder and see if the misfire moves
Inspect spark plug and injector

P0335.description: Crankshaft Position Sensor A Circuit Malfunction
follow_up_checks: Inspect sensor wiring and connector
Check sensor signal with a scope or workshop tool
Inspect exhaust for leaks
Compare upstream and downstream oxygen sensor readings

P0442.description: Evaporative Emission System Leak Detected (Small Leak)
follow_up_checks: Check the fuel cap and seal
Inspect EVAP hoses; use a smoke test if needed

P0455.description: Evaporative Emission System Leak Detected (Large Leak)
follow_up_checks: Check the fuel cap first
Inspect EVAP hoses and valves
Inspect sensor wiring and connector
Compare scanner speed with actual speed on a road test

possible_causes: Spark plug or ignition coil on cylinder 2
follow_up_checks: Swap coil with another cylinder and see if the misfire moves
Inspect spark plug and injector
